changelog_2026_07_03_same_day_fix_pass.note: See FULL-AUDIT-REPORT.md top section for full detail. Findings below are left as originally written (point-in-time audit record) but the following were fixed and verified via clean `npm run build` on 2026-07-03: duplicate static LocalBusiness JSON-LD block removed from index.html; a $$-to-$ priceRange corruption bug in prerender.js's String.replace() calls was found and fixed (7 call sites); og:image/logo repointed off 404ing assets; Service.provider and Review.itemReviewed switched to @id references; opening-hours schema corrected; dead linktr.ee sameAs removed, Wikidata sameAs added; homepage/llms.txt stale Combo price (R$320) corrected to the real active promo price (R$230); llms.txt glossary count corrected; CSP media-src added (unblocks /galeria video); /assets/* cache-control set to immutable; X-Robots-Tag noindex added for /admin and /cliente; WhatsApp button hidden on /agendar. Corrected as false positives: the IndexNow finding (audit checked the wrong filename) and part of the pricing finding (the R$230/R$320 split was an intentional promoPrice, not a bug). Still open: LCP/TBT performance work, /galeria server-side image rendering, /admin+/cliente shared-shell architecture, soft-404 template, blog-post WhatsApp overlap, all Phase 3 content authoring, near-duplicate blog post manual review, GA4 tag dedup, minor polish items.

summary.business_type: Local Service — Hair Salon (brick-and-mortar, single location), curly/wavy/coily hair specialist, Belo Horizonte, Brazil
top_findings: Pricing inconsistency for 'Combo Corte + Tratamento' across /faq (R$230), /investimento (R$190-230), homepage JSON-LD + llms.txt (R$320) — independently confirmed by 4 specialist agents (technical/sxo/geo/schema/local all touched it)

Duplicate @id LocalBusiness JSON-LD block is a live regression — a static block added to index.html in a recent commit duplicates the prerender.js dynamic block on every route, re-declaring the same @id as a separate object on / and /depoimentos

og:image (/capa-studio.jpg) and JSON-LD logo (/logo.png) both 404 site-wide, breaking every social share preview (Facebook, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, X) and degrading Merchant/Knowledge Panel image validation
/galeria is functionally broken: CSP has no media-src directive so a Firebase Storage gallery video is hard-blocked, and the page has zero tags in raw HTML (100% client-fetched)

Homepage LCP measured at 8.4s (Poor, threshold 4.0s) and TBT at 2,820ms — fully client-rendered hero with no fetchpriority/preload, third-party scripts (duplicate GA4 tag, Facebook Pixel, GTM) saturating the main thread
quick_wins: Repoint og:image + JSON-LD logo/image fields to the working /jon-perfil.webp asset (or restore the missing files) — one template edit fixes every social share preview site-wide
Remove the static duplicate LocalBusiness JSON-LD block from index.html — prerender.js already covers every route; this single edit also resolves the downstream priceRange conflict
Add media-src to the Content-Security-Policy header — unblocks the /galeria video immediately, a one-line config change
Reposition/z-index the WhatsApp floating bubble on mobile /agendar — it currently overlaps the primary 'Adicionar' button on the booking page, the most important conversion step
Standardize the 'Combo Corte + Tratamento' price to one number everywhere (copy + schema) — no dev work, just a content decision and 4 find-replace edits

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Sitemap lastmod fix from 2026-07-02 is holding — dates genuinely span 2026-03-30 to 2026-07-03
robots.txt correctly allows all major AI crawlers, blocks /admin and /cliente
Canonical tags self-referencing and consistent (www, https) across all page types sampled
Meta robots index,follow correct everywhere; no accidental noindex
Prerendered noscript content present in raw HTML for all page types — not JS-dependent for crawlers
Known redirects (/sobre-o-jon, old blog slug) both clean single-hop 301s

findings.title: /admin and /cliente return HTTP 200 with byte-identical homepage HTML
findings.description: Despite robots.txt Disallow, both routes return the exact same 21,341-byte prerendered homepage snapshot at the HTTP level, with the same canonical and index,follow meta robots — no real access control or distinct shell exists.
findings.recommendation: Return true 401/403 or a noindex shell for these routes at the edge/prerender layer.

findings.title: Soft-404 content mismatch
findings.description: Invalid URLs correctly return HTTP 404 status, but the response body is byte-identical to the homepage (same canonical→/, same index,follow).
findings.recommendation: Serve a distinct 404 template with noindex and no canonical-to-home.

findings.title: og:image and JSON-LD logo/image 404 site-wide
findings.description: /capa-studio.jpg (og:image, Twitter card, JSON-LD image) and /logo.png (JSON-LD logo) both 404, referenced on every page type. Working alternates exist: /logo-app.png, /jon-perfil.webp.
findings.recommendation: Restore the files or repoint prerender.js template + meta tags to /jon-perfil.webp.

findings.title: IndexNow key file still missing
findings.description: Confirmed still 404 at both /indexnow.txt and /.well-known/indexnow.txt — a previously-known open issue.
findings.recommendation: Deploy the IndexNow key file to production; verify the submission code path is actually wired to a live route.

findings.title: Bare-domain redirect has 2 hops; non-www uses 307 not 301
findings.description: http://ojonquecortou.com.br → 308 → https://ojonquecortou.com.br/ → 307 → https://www.ojonquecortou.com.br/.
findings.recommendation: Collapse to a single 301 hop straight to https+www.

findings.title: Pinch-zoom disabled
findings.description: Viewport meta uses user-scalable=no, maximum-scale=1.0 site-wide — a WCAG 1.4.4 accessibility anti-pattern.
findings.recommendation: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale=1.0 from the viewport meta tag.

findings.title: Google Fonts loaded without font-display/preload
findings.description: Render-blocking stylesheet from fonts.googleapis.com with no display=swap parameter and no preload hint — a plausible FOIT/LCP-delay contributor.
findings.recommendation: Add &display=swap to the Google Fonts URL, or self-host the fonts alongside other hashed assets.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Real founder specificity on /sobre — concrete origin story, all curl types named (2A-4C), not generic AI-credentialing language
Abundant AI-citable facts: specific prices, address, phone, technique durations
FAQPage schema with speakable markup correctly implemented on /faq
No duplicate-content problem across the 19 /servicos subpages — body copy genuinely distinct
Cannibalization fix (rotina-basica → cronograma-capilar) confirmed holding via curl -L; all 5 previously-applied CTR title rewrites render correctly

findings.title: Six /servicos subpages are thin, template-shaped (400-700 words)
findings.description: infusao-carga-hidrica-porosos, inside-trp, lavar-finalizar, pacote-cachos-perfeitos, protocolo-blindagem-ph-reconstrucao, retoque-raiz, ritual-reposicao-lipidica-nutricao all sit at 648-694 words vs 2,900w+ on flagship pages, same intro+price+CTA shape.
findings.recommendation: Expand to 1,200-1,500 words with 'para quem é indicado', technique steps, and FAQ-style objections — prioritize the high-ticket services first (inside-trp, protocolo-blindagem-ph-reconstrucao).

findings.title: Zero internal links from blog posts to /glossario despite heavy jargon use
findings.description: Checked 3 posts using terms like 'porosidade', 'fator de encolhimento', 'curvatura' extensively — 0 glossario links each, despite 46-58 blog-to-blog links per post. The 56-term glossary is effectively orphaned from the blog.
findings.recommendation: Add contextual first-mention links from blog posts to relevant glossário entries.

findings.title: 12+ posts frozen at dateModified = datePublished for 3+ months
findings.description: Posts dated 2026-04-13/04-14 show no distinct 'Atualizado em' signal despite being 13+ weeks stale as of 2026-07-03.
findings.recommendation: Refresh evergreen posts periodically and surface a real updated-date signal in the UI.

findings.title: Author attribution shallow on blog posts
findings.description: A 'Publicado em' byline + JSON-LD author field exist, but no in-article author-bio/credential block, unlike the rich bio on /sobre.
findings.recommendation: Add a compact reusable byline component linking to /sobre.

findings.title: /metodo's 7-step process isn't individually schema-marked
findings.description: The Leitura de Fio method is described in prose with no HowTo/numbered-list schema — a missed extraction opportunity for AI answer engines.
findings.recommendation: Mark up the 7 steps as a HowTo or ItemList schema.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: All 5 previously-flagged CTR title issues (wolf-cut, acidificacao, servicos, sobre, cronograma) confirmed fixed and rendering correctly
Canonical tags and meta robots are clean and consistent across every page type sampled
/investimento and /servicos are the correct page TYPES for transactional/pricing intent — prices are bold and bulleted, not buried in prose

findings.title: Pricing inconsistency on the money page (/investimento) and across the site
findings.description: /investimento's own title says 'a partir de R$200', its body says 'R$190 a R$230', and its schema PriceSpecification disagrees again (min190/max230). Separately, 'Combo Corte + Tratamento' shows R$230 on /faq, R$190-230 on /investimento, and R$320 on the homepage/llms.txt. Confirmed independently by 4 different specialist passes.
findings.recommendation: Pick one true price per service and propagate it identically across title tags, meta, on-page copy, JSON-LD, and llms.txt.

findings.title: /agendar (the conversion page) has almost no crawlable content
findings.description: Just 3 short paragraphs, no pricing recap, no trust signals — the weakest-content page at the most important funnel step.
findings.recommendation: Add richer fallback content: price recap, rating badge, and friction-reducers (e.g. surface the existing cancel/reschedule flexibility).

findings.title: Single, end-of-post CTA on long blog posts
findings.description: A 1,500+ word sample post had exactly one CTA, placed at the very last line, breaking the cold-blog-to-booking path.
findings.recommendation: Add mid-article and intro CTAs with a standardized, staged pattern across all 47 posts.

findings.title: No dedicated 'salão em Belo Horizonte' local-reinforcement per service page
findings.description: The ~18 individual /servicos/* pages rely on the shared footer for BH signal rather than reinforcing it in their own H1/intro.
findings.recommendation: Add a one-line local-context sentence to each service page's H1/intro area.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: JSON-LD used exclusively, correct https context, absolute URLs, ISO 8601 dates, no deprecated types
BreadcrumbList correctly formed on service and blog pages
Blog Article schema solid: headline, description, image, author via @id reference, dates, mainEntityOfPage
Service + nested Offer with typed price and priceCurrency BRL on the sampled service page — ready to scale to all 20 /servicos/* pages
AggregateRating (4.9/272) with 7 real Review nodes matching the site's own claim, not just prose
FAQPage on /faq (60+ Q&As) correctly retained for AI/GEO citation value despite Google retiring FAQ rich results 2026-05-07

findings.title: Sitewide duplicate @id LocalBusiness node — confirmed live regression
findings.description: A recent commit ('LocalBusiness schema estruturado no index.html base') added a static HairSalon/LocalBusiness block (@id=#localbusiness) to the base template. It now renders on every route ALONGSIDE the prerender.js-injected dynamic-page-schema block — and on / and /depoimentos the second block re-declares the same @id as a separate object. This is the exact regression risk previously flagged, now live again.
findings.recommendation: Remove the static schema block from index.html — prerender.js already covers every route (confirmed is_spa=false everywhere).

findings.title: priceRange conflict between the two duplicate homepage JSON-LD blocks
findings.description: Static block declares priceRange "$$", the dynamic-page-schema @graph block declares "$" — same root duplication issue as above.
findings.recommendation: Resolves automatically once the duplicate block is removed; establish single source of truth in prerender.js.

findings.title: Service.provider and all 7 Review.itemReviewed embed full inline LocalBusiness copies
findings.description: Instead of {"@id": "#localbusiness"} references, these embed anonymous full copies of the business entity — the Review copies don't even carry an @id.
findings.recommendation: Replace inline copies with @id references to the canonical LocalBusiness node.

findings.title: Article publisher is a disconnected identity
findings.description: The Article schema's publisher is an unlinked, @id-less Organization using a different logo file than the canonical business node — a third disconnected entity in the graph.
findings.recommendation: Reference the canonical Organization/LocalBusiness @id instead of declaring a separate publisher object.

findings.title: /depoimentos reviews lack datePublished and aren't tied to AggregateRating
findings.description: Downstream of the inline-copy issue above — reviews aren't structurally connected to the single canonical rating node.
findings.recommendation: Fix once Review.itemReviewed uses @id references; add datePublished to each review.

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: TTFB excellent everywhere (40-186ms) — Vercel edge + Cloudflare caching
CLS good on homepage: 0.024, well under the 0.1 threshold
HTTP/2+H3, zstd compression, and security headers all correctly configured
JS already code-split into hashed vendor/app chunks — good foundation

findings.title: LCP fails on homepage — 8.4s (Poor, threshold 4.0s)
findings.description: The site is entirely client-rendered React; #root ships empty from the server. No fetchpriority=high or preload hint exists for the LCP candidate.
findings.recommendation: Prerender the real hero markup server-side with explicit dimensions and fetchpriority=high, not just noscript text.

findings.title: Total Blocking Time 2,820ms
findings.description: Main thread saturated by third-party scripts: react-vendor 733ms, gtag.js (two separate configs) ~1.2s combined, gtm.js 611ms.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate to GTM-only tag firing and defer analytics until idle/interaction.

findings.title: 504 KiB of unused JavaScript, nearly all third-party
findings.description: Facebook Pixel 94% wasted, a duplicate/second GA4 stream (G-2HCS01RSP2 alongside G-BC8WXZKTLL) 65% wasted, firebase-vendor bundle 58% wasted globally.
findings.recommendation: Dedupe the GA4 tags and lazy-load Firebase only on pages that need it.

findings.title: /galeria is functionally broken and worse than home for LCP
findings.description: CSP has no media-src directive so a Firebase Storage gallery video is hard-blocked (console error confirmed). Raw HTML has zero tags anywhere — gallery content is 100% client-fetched from Firestore/Storage post-JS-boot, a multi-hop waterfall.
findings.recommendation: Add media-src to the CSP immediately (this is a functional bug, not just a perf issue) and prerender the first 2-4 gallery images server-side.

findings.title: Hashed static assets cached only 4 hours, not immutable
findings.description: Cache-Control: public, max-age=14400 on content-hashed JS/CSS that is safe to cache for a year.
findings.recommendation: Set max-age=31536000, immutable for /assets/*.

findings.title: Render-blocking third-party Google Fonts request
findings.description: display=swap is set correctly but the request still blocks first paint via an extra origin round-trip.
findings.recommendation: Self-host fonts alongside other hashed assets.

findings.title: Four independent analytics vendors fire on every page
findings.description: GTM, two gtag.js configs, two Meta Pixel IDs, and Ahrefs Analytics — the largest cumulative TBT contributor.
findings.recommendation: Route all tags through GTM with idle/scroll-gated triggers.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: Exceptional SSR/noscript fallback on every page — dense, fact-specific answer blocks (prices, percentages, addresses) fully visible to non-JS AI crawlers, plus a hidden nav repeating ~49 blog links as a crawlable internal sitemap
Full JSON-LD entity graph correctly links LocalBusiness + Person + WebSite by @id — textbook AI entity disambiguation for 'Studio do Jon'/'Jonatan Junior'
RSL 1.0 correctly declared (robots.txt License: + link rel=license) permitting ai-index/ai-include while prohibiting ai-train — an ideal posture for citation traffic without training exposure
/metodo is genuinely excellent: clinical-register prose with concrete numbers, near the optimal citation-passage length
60-term glossário in proper dl/dt/dd structure with source backlinks per term

findings.title: Pricing conflict across 3+ sources risks wrong-price AI citations
findings.description: Same root issue flagged by the schema, sxo, and local specialists — an AI system citing this site risks quoting the wrong price.
findings.recommendation: Reconcile to one true price across llms.txt, homepage schema, /faq, and /investimento.

findings.title: No Wikidata sameAs despite an existing entity
findings.description: Wikidata item Q140387726 exists (created 2026-06-30) but zero on-site references to it exist in any sameAs array.
findings.recommendation: Add https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q140387726 to prerender.js's localBusinessSchema.

findings.title: Zero YouTube/Reddit/LinkedIn presence
findings.description: YouTube is the strongest known AI-citation correlate (~0.737) among third-party platforms, and the business has no presence there.
findings.recommendation: Longer-term strategic gap — consider short-form video content repurposed from existing blog/method material.

findings.title: llms.txt under-represents content depth
findings.description: The file lists routes only; it doesn't sample any of the ~49 blog posts, 20+ FAQ pairs, or glossary terms.
findings.recommendation: Add a curated 'Principais Artigos' list plus 3-5 sample FAQ Q&As to llms.txt.

findings.title: llms.txt glossary count is stale
findings.description: File says '56 termos'; actual current count is 60.
findings.recommendation: Update the count or automate it at build time.

findings.title: No external authoritative citations
findings.description: Hurts visibility on Perplexity specifically, which weights well-sourced pages more heavily.
findings.recommendation: Pursue citations in beauty-press roundups (ties to the press-page recommendation under Backlinks).

categories.name: Images
what_works: Working image alternates exist and are correctly used elsewhere: /logo-app.png (apple-touch-icon), /jon-perfil.webp (Person schema image)
No broken images found on the core pages sampled outside of the og:image/logo/gallery issues below

findings.title: og:image and JSON-LD logo/image 404 site-wide
findings.description: Duplicate of the Technical SEO finding — /capa-studio.jpg and /logo.png both 404, referenced in meta tags and both JSON-LD blocks on every page.
findings.recommendation: Repoint to /jon-perfil.webp or restore the missing files.

findings.title: /galeria has zero tags in raw HTML
findings.description: All gallery imagery is 100% client-fetched post-JS-boot with no server-rendered fallback, and the accompanying video is CSP-blocked entirely.
findings.recommendation: Prerender the first 2-4 gallery images server-side; fix the CSP media-src gap.

findings.title: Possible lazy-load failure on homepage blog card thumbnails
findings.description: Unconfirmed: 3 related-article thumbnails showed complete:false/naturalWidth:0 after a 3s wait on both viewports tested, even though direct HTTP requests to those URLs return 200 with valid image data. Likely a lazy-load/intersection-observer timing issue, not missing files.
findings.recommendation: Manually scroll-confirm on a real device; check the intersection-observer threshold/rootMargin config for the blog card image component.

categories.name: Sitemap
what_works: XML well-formed, correct namespace; all 78 URLs checked return 100% HTTP 200 with zero redirects
Zero coverage gaps — every internal link discoverable from the site's own navigation is already in the sitemap
/cliente and /admin correctly absent from the sitemap and correctly Disallowed in robots.txt
rotina-basica confirmed removed from the sitemap and redirecting live
lastmod dates legitimately varied (not the old blanket-fake-date bug) — 40% sharing today's date is exactly the non-blog template pages, not a recurrence

findings.title: priority/changefreq present but ignored by Google
findings.description: Sane hierarchy exists but both fields have no ranking effect.
findings.recommendation: Optional cleanup only, not urgent.

findings.title: Sitemap index not yet needed
findings.description: 78 URLs is far under any practical splitting threshold.
findings.recommendation: Revisit only if blog volume approaches 500-1000 posts.

categories.name: Local SEO
what_works: NAP string byte-for-byte identical across homepage, /sobre, /agendar footers
Correct schema subtype (HairSalon + LocalBusiness), geo coordinates at 6-decimal precision
Google Maps embed confirmed present, correctly titled, pointed at the right address
'Belo Horizonte'/'Caiçaras'/'BH' repeated naturally across hero, /sobre, /servicos, testimonials — not a token mention
Click-to-call and click-to-WhatsApp both present together in the footer contact sentence on every page checked

findings.title: Opening hours: schema contradicts visible on-page text
findings.description: Visible UI reads Tuesday-Friday 9h-19h / Saturday 9h-17h (closed Sun+Mon), but JSON-LD openingHoursSpecification declares Monday-Saturday uniformly 09:00-19:00 on every page.
findings.recommendation: Fix prerender.js's schema generator to emit two correct day-range blocks matching the real hours.

findings.title: Testimonials lack dates/photos and per-review schema
findings.description: 7 named, geo-tagged testimonials on /depoimentos have no dates, making review recency/velocity unverifiable from the page itself; only the aggregate rating is marked up.
findings.recommendation: Add dates to displayed testimonials and per-review schema tied to the canonical business @id.

findings.title: No dedicated 'salão em Belo Horizonte' pillar page
findings.description: Defensible for a single-location business (avoids doorway-page risk), but individual service pages could do more work reinforcing locality themselves.
findings.recommendation: Reinforce BH context in each /servicos/* page's own H1/intro rather than relying only on the shared footer.

categories.name: Search Experience (SXO)
what_works: /investimento and /servicos are the correct page types for transactional/pricing intent, with prices bold and bulleted up front
'Faz química?' is answered explicitly and marked up as FAQPage — a strong, citable answer for the chemical-avoidance persona
/metodo (Leitura de Fio) is a genuinely differentiated asset — no competitor found across 4 SERP checks has an equivalent named method

findings.title: No content asset for 'best-of'/comparison search intent
findings.description: 'Melhor salão cabelo crespo BH' is dominated by competitors and third-party listicles that don't mention the site.
findings.recommendation: Build a differentiation page and pursue citations in existing roundups.

findings.title: Cluster fragmentation dilutes ranking authority
findings.description: Transição capilar and cronograma capilar intents split across 3-4 near-duplicate assets with no pillar hierarchy; neither surfaces in real SERPs while single-asset competitors dominate.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate into pillar pages — see Content Architecture category.

findings.title: Domain identity inconsistency in search-facing citations
findings.description: A WebSearch check surfaced 'ojonquecortou.com' (no www/.br) alongside the real domain.
findings.recommendation: Audit GBP and third-party citations for NAP/URL consistency.

categories.name: Content Architecture (Clustering)
what_works: Strong topical depth: 47 posts show genuine subtopic differentiation in most clusters
The cronograma-capilar cannibalization pair was already resolved via 301 redirect — good hygiene precedent
/metodo and /glossario both already link out to 30-50 posts each, giving genuine internal-link density
Matching /servicos/* pages exist for most content themes — the conversion inventory exists, just not consistently wired to content

findings.title: Near-identical slugs likely duplicate content — highest-priority manual check
findings.description: corte-a-seco-cabelo-cacheado-bh-volume vs corte-para-cabelo-cacheado-bh-volume both target BH+volume+cut intent with nearly identical slugs — same pattern as the already-fixed cronograma pair.
findings.recommendation: Manually verify; merge/redirect if confirmed duplicate, following the cronograma precedent.

findings.title: No formal pillar pages for 3 of 4 major topic clusters
findings.description: Frizz (5 posts), porosidade/pH, and cortes/tendências (9 posts) have zero curated pillar — only the flat /metodo and /glossario directories.
findings.recommendation: Build 3 pillar pages (2,500-4,000 words) synthesizing each cluster with mandatory bidirectional links to every spoke.

findings.title: Near-duplicate 'day after' posts
findings.description: fim-do-bad-hair-day-after and day-after-cabelo-cacheado-bh-como-reativar-sem-lavar appear to target the identical intent.
findings.recommendation: Verify via title/H1; merge/redirect if confirmed, following the cronograma precedent.

findings.title: Transição capilar cluster (3 posts) lacks pillar hierarchy
findings.description: No confirmed cross-linking or hub declaration despite /servicos/transicao-capilar existing as a natural conversion target.
findings.recommendation: Make the 'sem-sofrimento-guia' post the pillar, linking to both spokes and the service page.

findings.title: Wolf cut vs shag cacheado — borderline cannibalization
findings.description: Both are 2026-trend curly-cut articles with overlapping intent; differentiation exists in principle but reciprocal cross-linking wasn't confirmed.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit comparison cross-links ('Wolf cut ou shag — qual combina com seu cacho?').

categories.name: Visual / Mobile
what_works: Mobile homepage nails the above-the-fold: name, location, H1 value prop, and primary CTA all visible without scrolling
Dark theme has strong, consistent contrast — no low-contrast text observed anywhere
No horizontal scroll/overflow on any of the 8 page/viewport combinations tested
Blog post has a persistent sticky booking CTA reinforcing conversion intent

findings.title: WhatsApp bubble overlaps primary CTA on /agendar mobile
findings.description: The fixed WhatsApp widget sits directly on top of the first service card's 'Adicionar' button, text visibly clipped — this is the core conversion action on the most important page.
findings.recommendation: Reposition the WhatsApp bubble or add bottom padding/z-index management so it never covers primary buttons.

findings.title: Same overlap pattern on blog post mobile footer
findings.description: The sticky booking bar sits adjacent to/behind the WhatsApp bubble at the bottom-right.
findings.recommendation: Same fix as above, applied to the blog post template.

findings.title: Small tap targets on /agendar service cards
findings.description: 'Ver descrição completa' toggles are 151x23px, half the 44px guideline, sitting directly above the real action button — a mis-tap risk during the booking flow specifically.
findings.recommendation: Increase toggle height to at least 44px or add spacing from the action button.

findings.title: Font-family mismatch on /agendar header
findings.description: 'Studio do Jon' renders in a serif font while the rest of the site uses sans-serif/mono.
findings.recommendation: Align to the site's standard type system; likely unintended.

categories.name: Backlinks
what_works: Google Business Profile/Maps citation is live and verified, the core local-SEO citation anchor
Instagram and Facebook profile links are live and verified
A genuine, well-documented differentiator story already exists on-site ('Método Leitura de Fio')
A Wikidata entity (Q140387726, created 2026-06-30) is live and correctly points back to the site

findings.title: Broken link inside structured data (linktr.ee)
findings.description: The homepage Person sameAs JSON-LD (both schema blocks) lists https://linktr.ee/ojonquecortou, which returns HTTP 404 (verified twice, different user agents).
findings.recommendation: Remove or restore the linktr.ee link in prerender.js's localBusinessSchema — same edit location as the Wikidata sameAs addition.

findings.title: No press/media page
findings.description: /imprensa and /na-midia both 404. The 'Leitura de Fio' story has no packaged asset (bio, photos, pitch) for journalists/directories to pick up from.
findings.recommendation: Build a simple press page — highest-leverage low-cost link-building fix identified in this audit.

findings.title: No numeric score assigned — insufficient data
findings.description: Ahrefs MCP returned 'Insufficient plan' on all site-explorer calls; Moz/Bing/DataForSEO are unconfigured; Common Crawl returned zero data for this domain (in_crawl:false, normal for a smaller/newer domain, not a negative signal). A fabricated 0-100 number would be misleading.
findings.recommendation: Re-check Common Crawl quarterly; consider a Moz free-tier key (2,500 rows/month) for basic DA/PA visibility.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Remove the static duplicate LocalBusiness JSON-LD block from index.html (resolves the @id duplication + priceRange conflict in one edit)
Standardize the 'Combo Corte + Tratamento' price (and check other services) to one number across /faq, /investimento, homepage schema, and llms.txt
Repoint og:image and JSON-LD logo/image fields to /jon-perfil.webp (or restore /capa-studio.jpg and /logo.png)
Add media-src to the Content-Security-Policy header to unblock the /galeria video (functional bug, not just SEO)
Reposition/z-index the WhatsApp bubble on mobile /agendar so it stops covering the primary booking CTA
Fix homepage LCP: prerender real hero markup server-side with fetchpriority=high and explicit image dimensions
Deploy the IndexNow key file to production at /indexnow.txt and /.well-known/indexnow.txt

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Fix opening-hours schema to match the real Tuesday-Friday/Saturday-only hours shown in the UI
Fix /admin and /cliente to return true 401/403 or a distinct noindex shell instead of the homepage snapshot; fix the soft-404 body to match
Replace Service.provider and all Review.itemReviewed inline copies with @id references to the canonical LocalBusiness node
Dedupe the two GA4 tags and lazy-load Firebase only where needed (504 KiB unused JS)
Set Cache-Control to max-age=31536000, immutable for hashed /assets/*
Add real content to /agendar (price recap, rating badge, cancel/reschedule flexibility) — it's the conversion page with almost no crawlable content
Add mid-article and intro CTAs to blog posts, not just end-of-post
Manually verify and merge/redirect corte-a-seco-cabelo-cacheado-bh-volume vs corte-para-cabelo-cacheado-bh-volume (likely duplicate, same pattern as the fixed cronograma pair)
Add Wikidata sameAs (https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q140387726) and remove the dead linktr.ee link, both in the same prerender.js edit

items: Build 3 pillar pages (2,500-4,000 words) for the frizz, porosidade/pH, and cortes/tendências clusters with bidirectional spoke links
Verify and merge/redirect the near-duplicate 'day after' posts if confirmed
Add explicit comparison cross-links between wolf-cut and shag-cacheado posts
Add contextual links from blog posts to /glossario on first jargon mention
Refresh the 12+ stale posts (dateModified frozen 3+ months) and add a visible 'Atualizado em' signal
Build a press/media page and pursue beauty-press outreach using the 'Leitura de Fio' differentiator story
Add dates and per-review schema to /depoimentos testimonials
Reinforce 'Belo Horizonte' locally in each /servicos/* page's own H1/intro
Expand llms.txt with a curated 'Principais Artigos' list and sample FAQ Q&As
Build a comparison/'best-of' content asset to compete for 'melhor salão cabelo crespo BH' intent
Self-host Google Fonts and add HowTo schema to the /metodo 7-step process

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Seed a drift baseline now (no prior baseline existed) so future audits can detect regressions automatically — the duplicate-schema regression in this audit would have been caught immediately by drift monitoring
Re-check Common Crawl backlink data quarterly; consider a free-tier Moz key for basic DA/PA visibility
Track GSC/GA4 impact after the pricing-consistency and image fixes ship
Re-measure Core Web Vitals after the LCP/TBT fixes ship (lab tools here had no PageSpeed API key — consider adding one for field data)
Polish remaining Low-severity items: pinch-zoom, font-family mismatch on /agendar, minor sub-44px tap targets, bare-domain redirect hop collapse
